input.objective: Document the pre-release verification contract consistently in README.md and docs/execution-architecture.md. The README should give operators a concise checklist; the architecture page should explain why typecheck, tests, and sandbox image verification are distinct evidence. Keep both descriptions aligned and prove the package remains healthy.

context.purpose: Evaluate cross-file investigation, terminology reconciliation, dependency-aware planning, and independent verification.

constraints: Do not duplicate existing sections or make claims not supported by package scripts.
Run npm run check and npm run sandbox:check.
Do not publish, deploy, tag, or push anything.
